label: ProBlogger Jobs
terms_note: Public WordPress RSS; no terms read; no items.

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (RSS exists but is EMPTY) Confidence high (feed opened twice, 2026-09-02 and today).
auth: 1. No account needed for the public feed; the tenant applies on the posting's own application page (assist card).
reference.limits: - No terms read; scanning returns [] silently.

adapter.terms: ProBlogger Jobs public WordPress feed. Apply through each listing.

search_postings.note: ProBlogger Job Board RSS of active postings (WPJobBoard, RSS 2.0): GET /jobs/wpjobboard/xml/rss/?filter=active, with `query` carried into the board's search (?query=writer narrows it). The WordPress /jobs/feed/ used before carried no <item> elements on 2026-09-25 and 2026-09-26 while this feed listed the board's live postings (live check 2026-09-26). The feed is one list, so page and limit are not sent (next_page is always null); category, min_budget are not sent. Items use the standard RSS fields (title, link, pubDate, description); id is the posting link.

not_offered.me: No credentials to verify ('auth: none'): the feed is public and has no account endpoint.
not_offered.get_posting: The feed has no per-item endpoint; each posting's page (url) is HTML only. search_postings returns the whole record.
not_offered.submit_bid: Applications go through each listing; ProBlogger Jobs publishes no API and its REST index has no job-listing route.
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API; only the public feed is machine-readable.
not_offered.send_message: No messaging API; only the public feed is machine-readable.
not_offered.credits: No account or credit endpoint; the feed is keyless.

live_check.notes: fixed: /jobs/feed/ carries no items; now the board's WPJobBoard feed (/jobs/wpjobboard/xml/rss/?filter=active) with query; all read tools answered, schema-valid
